name: portcheck
title: Portcheck
description: See what's using a port and stop it safely: every listening port with its process, who started it, and one-key stop, open and copy.
author: roystondwork-dev

commands.name: search-ports
commands.title: Search Ports
commands.subtitle: Portcheck
commands.description: Every port listening on this Mac, with its process, PID and user; stop it, open it or copy its PID.

commands.name: check-port
commands.title: Check Port
commands.subtitle: Portcheck
commands.description: Is a port free? If not, which process holds it and who started it.

commands.name: kill-port
commands.title: Kill Port
commands.subtitle: Portcheck
commands.description: Stop whatever is listening on a port, after confirming. Never stops system processes.

commands.name: free-port
commands.title: Find Free Port
commands.subtitle: Portcheck
commands.description: Copy a free port, optionally in a range such as 3000-3999.

preferences.name: portcheckPath
preferences.title: portcheck Path
preferences.description: Path to the portcheck binary. Leave empty to find it in Homebrew, ~/.local/bin, ~/go/bin or PATH.
